docs.title: Nexus Sports theme
docs.text:
Nexus Sports is a BigCommerce Stencil theme for sports, running, outdoor and training stores. This guide covers everything you need to set it up and run it.

  • Theme: Nexus Sports 1.0.0, built on Cornerstone 6.21.0
  • Live demo: https://nexus-sports-demo.mybigcommerce.com
  • Support: https://papathemes.com/contact-us/ · contact@papathemes.com

docs.title: What you get
docs.text:
• Four variations: Track, Trail, Velo and Flow. Each has its own colours and hero panel. See Choose a variation.
  • A homepage built from blocks that you switch on and off: hero, flash sale countdown, trust bar, sport links, featured products, new arrivals, brand strip, blog and a shop-the-look photo grid.
  • 40 Page Builder regions, so you can add banners and text without editing code. See Page Builder regions.
  • Product cards that read your catalog: sale, sold out, low stock, pre-order and your own labels, with no theme setting to maintain.
  • Dark and light mode, with a switch in the top bar.
  • Mega menu, quick view, cart drawer, list or grid view, product comparison and faceted search.
  • Accessible: all text meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast in both colour modes, and every control works from the keyboard.

docs.title: Where to start
docs.text:
1. Install and apply the theme.
  2. Choose a variation.
  3. Open Theme Styles and set up the homepage.
  4. Fill the Page Builder regions with your own banners and links.

First release.

  • Four variations: Track, Trail, Velo, Flow.
  • Homepage with hero and side panel, flash sale countdown, trust bar, sport links, featured products, new arrivals, brand strip, blog and shop-the-look grid.
  • 40 Page Builder regions, eight of them global.
  • Product cards with sale, sold-out, low-stock, pre-order and custom labels, colour dots and a feature line from custom fields.
  • Mega menu, quick view, cart drawer with free-shipping bar, grid and list view, product comparison, faceted search.
  • Dark and light mode.
  • Built on Cornerstone 6.21.0.

docs.title: Updating
docs.text: Theme updates arrive in Storefront › Themes. Updating replaces the theme files; your Theme Styles values, Page Builder content and catalog stay as they are.

docs.title: Support
docs.text:
• Contact form: https://papathemes.com/contact-us/
  • Email: contact@papathemes.com

When you write in, include:

  • your store URL,
  • the variation you use,
  • a screenshot of the problem and the page it happens on.

That is usually enough to answer on the first reply.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
The homepage hero is missing. Either Show Hero is off (Theme Styles › Homepage), or the carousel has no slides and the fallback heading is empty. Add a slide in Storefront › Home page carousel or fill in the fallback fields.

The panel beside the hero is missing. Its Page Builder region (home_hero_stats, home_hero_quote or home_hero_gallery) is empty, which hides the panel. Add a widget, or set Hero side panel to Product.

The flash sale strip disappeared. The deadline has passed, or Flash sale deadline is empty.

Category pages show no filters. Product Filtering is not on your plan, or no filters are enabled in Products › Product filtering. Category pages still show the category tree and sorting.

The footer has no social icons. Add your profiles in Storefront › Social media links and drag each network into Live on your storefront. Filling in a link without dragging it does not publish it.

A setting will not save. Almost always the 64-character limit on theme settings. Shorten the text, or move it into a Page Builder widget.

Text is hard to read after I changed a colour. Colours are not checked when you edit them. Look at the page in both dark and light mode after any colour change.

My changes to theme files disappeared after an update. Updates replace theme files. Keep customisations in Page Builder, Theme Styles or Storefront › Script manager, which updates do not touch.

docs.title: Choose a variation
docs.text:
A variation is a preset: the same templates with different colours and homepage choices. You pick one when you apply the theme, and you can switch at any time in Theme Styles › Styles without losing content.

Variation Accent Beside the hero Off by default Made for Nexus Track Red #C8102E Three stats — Running and training Nexus Trail Burnt orange #B4531C Athlete quote Flash sale Outdoor, hiking, trail Nexus Velo Blue #0C6BD6 Your first featured product Trust bar Cycling, wearables Nexus Flow Green #2F7D5B Photo gallery Flash sale, brand strip Yoga, studio, wellness

Everything in the table can be changed after you apply: the accent colour in Theme colors, the hero panel in Homepage › Hero side panel, and each homepage block in Homepage.

Switching variations

Switching applies that variation's preset values on top of your settings. If you have changed colours or homepage blocks, note your values first.

docs.title: Set up the homepage
docs.text: The homepage is a stack of blocks. Theme Styles › Homepage switches them on and off, and Page Builder holds their content. A block you switch off leaves no gap.

docs.title: Hero
docs.text:
The hero reads the first slide of your carousel (Storefront › Home page carousel). Set the slide's image, heading, text, button label and link there. Only the first slide is shown; drag a slide to the first position to use it.

  • Image: at least 1920 × 1080, landscape, subject right of centre. The theme darkens the left side so the heading stays readable. On very wide screens the whole image is shown and its left edge fades into the background.
  • Accent word: wrap a word in asterisks, for example Fuel *your* game. It shows in your accent colour.

Settings in Theme Styles › Homepage › Hero section:

Setting Effect Show Hero Shows or hides the hero Small line above the hero heading For example Season 2026 Collection. Empty hides it Second hero button label / link An outlined button next to the slide's button Hero side panel What sits beside the hero: Stats, Quote, Gallery or Product (see below) Hero heading / description / button (used when the carousel is empty) A working hero before you add any slide

The row of sport links under the buttons is a widget in the home_hero_links region. Edit or delete it in Page Builder.

docs.title: Hero side panel
docs.text:
Choice Shows Content comes from Stats Three figures Page Builder region home_hero_stats Quote An athlete quote Page Builder region home_hero_quote Gallery A photo grid Page Builder region home_hero_gallery Product Your first featured product Nothing to set up

An empty region hides the panel, and the hero copy then takes the full width.

docs.title: Flash sale strip
docs.text:
A red strip with a countdown and a button.

  • Flash sale deadline takes a date and time such as 2026-12-31T23:59:59. Empty hides the strip; after the deadline the strip hides itself.
  • The label, heading and button are a widget in the home_flash_sale region.

docs.title: Free-shipping progress bar
docs.text: Free shipping threshold is the cart total at which shipping becomes free, as a plain number such as 150. The cart page and the cart drawer show a bar counting down to it. Empty hides the bar. Keep it in line with your real shipping rules in Settings › Shipping.

docs.title: Product sections
docs.text:
Setting Effect Show Featured Products Products you marked Featured in the catalog Featured products: small line / heading / View all link The text above that section Show New Arrivals Your newest products New arrivals: small line / heading / View all link The text above that section

The number of products in each section is set in Products › Number of products displayed.

docs.title: Other blocks
docs.text: Block Switch Content Trust bar (shipping, returns, secure checkout) Show Trust Bar Widget in home_trust_bar Sport links strip — Widget in home_below_trust Brand strip Show Brands Widget in home_brand_strip From the blog — Your three latest blog posts Shop the look — Photo grid widget in home_social_grid; the follow button links to your first social network Newsletter Show Newsletter BigCommerce newsletter sign-up

docs.title: Top bar
docs.text:
The strip above the header, set in Theme Styles › Header and footer › Top bar: a message, an optional link text and the link URL.

Avoid a fixed amount in the message ("over $150") unless it matches your real free-shipping rule and currency. The right side of the top bar holds the currency picker (shown when the store has two or more currencies) and the dark/light switch.

docs.title: Menu
docs.text: The header menu is your category tree. Top-level categories are the menu items. Hovering one opens a mega menu: each second-level category is a column title and its third-level categories are the links below. The header_mega_feature--global region adds a promo tile to the mega menu.

docs.title: Install and apply
docs.text: Nexus Sports needs no app and no extra plan beyond a standard BigCommerce subscription.

docs.title: Add the theme to your store
docs.text:
1. In your control panel, go to Storefront › Themes › Themes marketplace.
  2. Find Nexus Sports and click Add to store. The theme appears in your Theme library.
  3. Click Apply theme, pick a variation, and confirm.

Your products, categories, web pages, navigation and settings carry over untouched. The theme never changes catalog data. Your previous theme stays in the Theme library, so you can switch back at any time.

docs.title: Plan-dependent features
docs.text:
Two features depend on your BigCommerce plan or settings. Without them the theme still works and simply leaves them out:

Feature Needs Filters on category pages (price, brand, size) A plan that includes Product Filtering, and filters set up in Products › Product filtering Gift certificates Gift certificates enabled in Settings › Gift certificates

docs.title: After you apply
docs.text:
• Upload your logo in Storefront › Logo. Without one, the store name shows as text.
  • Add your social profiles in Storefront › Social media links. The footer shows an icon for each network you drag into Live on your storefront.
  • Set your support email, phone and hours in Theme Styles › Contact page. They appear on the contact page and in the footer.
  • Continue with Choose a variation.

docs.title: Page Builder regions
docs.text:
Nexus Sports gives you 40 regions: places on the storefront where you can drop Page Builder widgets (text, images, banners, buttons, HTML) without editing code.

  1. Go to Storefront › Themes › Edit in Page Builder.
  2. Pick the page from the Page menu at the top left.
  3. Drag a widget from the left panel onto a dashed Drag and drop widgets here box.
  4. Publish.

An empty region takes no space on the live store, so you can leave any of them empty.

Global regions

Regions whose name ends in --global sit in the header, footer or cart drawer. A widget placed in one shows on every page at once: build your footer once, not once per page type.

docs.title: Custom page layouts
docs.text:
Three layouts ship with the theme. Two are for web pages and one for a category; they are not interchangeable.

Layout Applies to Use nexus-shop-by-category Web page A grid of every category with its image nexus-size-guide Web page Size tables that read well on phones nexus-flash-sale Category Discounted products with the countdown
  • Web page: Storefront › Web pages, edit the page, choose the layout under Template layout file.
  • Flash sale: create a category such as Sale, add your discounted products, then set its Template layout file to nexus-flash-sale in Products › Product categories.

docs.title: Category pages
docs.text: The banner at the top of a category shows the category image, name, description and product count. Write a one-line description for each category in Products › Product categories; without one the banner shows only the name.

docs.title: Blog
docs.text:
• Blog page › Blog Posts Per Page sets 6, 9 or 12 posts per page.
  • Tags on your posts become filter chips above the list.
  • Two Page Builder regions let you add content: blog_below_content under the post list and blog_post_below_content under each post.

docs.title: Contact page
docs.text: Theme Styles › Contact page holds your support email, phone and opening hours. They show beside the contact form and in the footer. The contact_below_form region under the form suits an FAQ.

docs.title: Footer
docs.text:
• The link columns are the global regions footer_column_1--global to footer_column_3--global. Place a widget once and it shows on every page.
  • footer_brand--global holds the short text under your logo, and footer_bottom--global the strip at the very bottom.
  • Your email, phone and the address from Settings › Store profile appear with icons under the logo.
  • Social icons come from Storefront › Social media links. Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, LinkedIn and TikTok get their own icon.
  • The copyright line uses the current year and your store name.

docs.title: Dark and light mode
docs.text: Shoppers switch mode with the button in the top bar, and the choice is kept on their device. Theme colors › Default color mode sets what a first-time visitor sees. Every colour has a dark and a light value; after changing a colour, check both modes for readable text.

docs.title: Product cards
docs.text:
Every state on a product card is read from your catalog. There is nothing to switch on in the theme.

Card shows Set it in Sale label and struck-through price A sale price on the product Sold out label, faded image, disabled button Inventory tracking with stock 0, and Settings › Inventory › Show out of stock message Only 3 left Inventory tracking, and Settings › Inventory › Stock level display set to Show when low Pre-order label, release date, amber button Availability › Pre-order with a release date Best seller, New or any other label A custom field named exactly Badge; its value is the label Colour dots A custom field named Swatches with hex colours, for example #111111, #C8102E Short feature line A custom field named Features, for example Lightweight · Breathable No reviews yet Shown when a product has no approved reviews

A card shows one label at a time, in this order: Sold out, Pre-order, your own label, Sale. The Badge, Swatches and Features fields are hidden from the Specifications tab and the compare page.

The buy button follows the product: Add to cart for simple products, Choose options when a size or colour must be picked, Pre-order now for pre-order items. Adding to the cart opens the cart drawer instead of leaving the page. Each card also has Quick view and a wishlist heart.

docs.title: Card and grid settings
docs.text:
Setting (Theme Styles › Products) Effect Grid Columns Products per row on category pages: 3 or 4 Show Brand Name Brand name above the product name

Shoppers can switch between grid and list view on category, brand and search pages; the choice is remembered on their device.

These features follow your store settings, so they stay the same whichever theme you use:

Feature Where Star ratings and reviews Settings › Display › Product ratings / reviews Wishlist Settings › Display › Wishlist Compare checkbox Settings › Display › Product comparisons Add to cart on cards Settings › Display › Show "Add to Cart" buttons

docs.title: Product page
docs.text:
• The trust promises under the buy button (shipping, returns, authenticity) are a widget in the product_trust_badges region. Edit them to match your policies.
  • The Size guide button next to the size option opens the content of the product_size_guide region. Leave it empty and the button hides.
  • Related products let shoppers tick several items and add them together. Products with options show their own Choose options button instead. The list is BigCommerce's related products (Products › Edit › Related products).

docs.title: Writing descriptions
docs.text: Quick view, list view and the compare page show a shortened description that keeps the first paragraphs and drops headings and lists. Start each description with one or two plain sentences that sum the product up.

docs.title: Theme Styles
docs.text:
Every theme setting lives in Theme Styles, inside Page Builder.

  1. Go to Storefront › Themes and click Edit in Page Builder on the current theme.
  2. Click the palette icon in the left bar. Theme Styles opens.
  3. Pick a group, change values, and watch the preview update.
  4. Click Save to keep a draft, or Publish to make it live.

docs.title: The groups
docs.text:
Group What it holds Styles Switch variation Global Background, text, heading and form colours, page and image options Header and footer Top bar message and link, logo, navigation, social icons, footer Homepage Hero, flash sale, free-shipping bar, section headings, block switches Products Grid columns, brand on cards, sale badges, product page options Buttons and icons Primary, secondary and tertiary button colours Checkout page Colours and fonts of the BigCommerce checkout Theme colors Default colour mode, primary and accent colours, dark-mode palette Contact page Support email, phone and opening hours Blog page Posts per page Advanced Content width, breadcrumbs

The full list, with the default value of each setting, is in the Settings reference.

64-character limit

BigCommerce rejects any theme setting longer than 64 characters when the theme saves. Keep headings short; put longer text in a Page Builder widget.
